nodes.label: B-071: B-070 Options and Desk Editor Ontology Require Correction
nodes.description: Handoff status: Answered, Resolution Verified, by Lane B's independent Re-close review (e5c5d58, read at f8b593a), for its documentary return episode only; the D-171 S2 hold and its technical target stay held. Lane B's spec-defect finding that neither of B-070's two S2 authorization options is approvable after the Judge's T5/T6 clarifications. Records a terminology map (ROLE-DESK-EDITOR vs NODE-EDITORIAL-DESK-REVIEW, plus sibling NODE-CHIEF-JOURNALIST-REVIEW), a normalized target model, and the Judge's direct four-identifier ruling (agent_id / agent_run_id / agent_attempt_badge_id / executor_principal_key; self_asserted rejected for executor comparison; no fifth Article-50 external-reader token). The corrective decision D-182 remains proposed, not in force. Judge approval covers the identifier ruling and a narrow Graphify tooling/status precondition only; AUTH-DOC is not approved. The implementation plan (V1-B071-CORRECTIVE-PLAN.md) is at Draft 12, carrying the D-188 correction packet, with plan approval none (B071-R67); Draft 11 and earlier are superseded drafts. The four-checkpoint approval structure is named AUTH-DOC / AUTH-F1 / AUTH-F2 / AUTH-ROUTE. History: findings B071-R1 onward were raised across independent-review rounds, with the Chief Editor's B071-R22 clarification. This node represents lifecycle status only; it does not assert the disputed ontology as decided, which remains the Judge's call.
nodes.rationale: B071-R15: round-2 independent review could not use graphify to locate the draft it was reviewing because neither B-071 nor its plan had a curated node, keeping graph-coverage red by design. A lifecycle-status node resolves that without pre-empting the Judge's content decision.

nodes.label: V1-B071-CORRECTIVE-PLAN.md: T5/T6 Ontology Correction Implementation Plan (DRAFT)
nodes.description: Status: DRAFT, proposed, Draft 11. Its proposal content (D-182 decision text, ontology relabel including NODE-CHIEF-JOURNALIST-REVIEW, three-act T5 completion unit keyed on executor_principal_key, Final Sign-Off correction using accountable-principal language, B-070 feature split per B071-R22, four-identifier data-contract ownership, named UX-*/SPECS-* artifact paths, and a full propagation write set) is unapplied to any governed tier; the file's own existence as an artifact is applied (V1-ARTIFACT-INVENTORY.md row) per B071-R23. Awaiting independent review (round 8 complete, findings B071-R56-R60 incorporated; round 9 outstanding) and a four-checkpoint AUTH-DOC / AUTH-F1 / AUTH-F2 / AUTH-ROUTE Judge approval structure (B071-R25-R27, renamed B071-R30), now split per B071-R56 into a text-only plan-review checklist, an optional Graphify tooling/status precondition, and a post-AUTH-DOC applied-state checklist. Judge approval: the identifier ruling and the tooling/status precondition only -- AUTH-DOC itself is none. To be retired or marked historical, never deleted, once D-182 lands.
nodes.rationale: B071-R15/R16: represents the draft's lifecycle status (DRAFT/proposed) and its Inventory registration so the plan is discoverable without approving its content.

nodes.label: B-072: Handoff-Only Commit Authority Is Ambiguous Outside the Active Lane
nodes.description: Handoff status: Answered, Resolution Applied (non-terminal; its SV-002 row is closed by its own D-403 reason). Distinguishes the exclusive work-product commit lock (Active lane only) from a narrow handoff-journal commit permission for Eligible Lane B/C actors, covering their own docs/handoff/B-NNN-*.md and C-NNN-*.md entries only. Judge authority: D-184 (2026-09-03) issued the standing permission: an Eligible Lane B or Lane C actor may commit and push only its own explicit handoff entry, authorizing no other path, broad or mixed staging, implementation, lane transition, Applied-to-Verified promotion or deployment; D-272 later amended it (the raiser owns and commits its series; the receiver answers and commits). History: the entry proposed a parent decision plus three children (safe commit protocol, Graphify-honesty obligation, propagation/enforcement); deferred hardening is not delivered.
nodes.rationale: graph-coverage requires every docs/handoff/*.md file to have a curated node (D-103's directory stays unmapped, not ungraphed); a status-only node avoids pre-empting the Judge's decision on B-072's content.
